info.title: Cryptex 2.0.0 - encrypt and decrypt files and folders with AES-256-GCM
info.description: A free command-line tool for encrypting and decrypting files and folders using AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption. Provided "as is", without warranty of any kind.

options.name: --passphrase
options.description:
Passphrase (visible to other processes and shell history;
prefer the prompt or the environment variable)

options.name: --delete-original
options.description: Delete source files after successful encryption

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the version
Passphrase sources, in order: --passphrase, the CRYPTEX_PASSPHRASE environment
variable, then an interactive prompt.
Existing output files are overwritten. Markdown files (.md, .markdown) are never
encrypted. There is no way to recover data if the passphrase is lost.
Cryptex is free software provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. See the
MIT license at https://github.com/greatb/Cryptex/blob/main/LICENSE
